newsitem.title: UK: Buyers sidelined on the UK meals/feeds market.
newsitem.headline: Buyers sidelined on the UK meals/feeds market.

text.p: Higher futures prices in Chicago and increases of as much as three stg a tonne in high pro prices on the UK meals and feeds market kept most buyers sidelined.
"People are beginning to realise that prices are not going to come down suddenly but that does not make them any keener to get involved," said one broker.
"We've got some USDA figures due out on Tuesday and some people are holding on in case they make a dent in the market, but even if they do it will be only temporally," said another.
High protein soymeal ex-mill Liverpool was offered three stg up while stores were one to three stg higher.
Rapemeal ex-mill Erith was unchanged while resellers were unchanged to one stg up.
Rapemeal from the Liverpool and Hull mills were unchanged to two stg higher.
Corn gluten feed pellets ex-store were around one to two stg up while sunflower meal ex-store and pellets ex-mill unchanged.
